newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan FGEP group buys 54,000T US corn.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan FGEP group buys 54,000T US corn.

text.p: Taiwan's FGEP group bought a 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. corn from Mitsui at a tender on Tuesday, traders said.
The corn was bought FOB at 58.5 U.S. cents over March Chicago futures, all in one shipment from trading giant Mitsui & Co Ltd, traders said.
Freight was fixed at US$11.9 per tonne.
Shipment was slated for February 26 to March 13 from the Pacific Northwest, they said.
The FGEP group last entered the grain market on October 24, buying two 54,000-tonne shipments of U.S. corn at tender.
The group comprises Fwu Sow Grain, Great Wall Enterprises, President Enterprises and unlisted Ever Smile Feed Mill Co.
